latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Opus Clip (version 1.0.0):

- Allows users to convert long-form videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) into short, shareable clips using cloud GPU processing.
- Simple setup: Generates or accepts an API token, establishes a session automatically, and confirms readiness to the user.
- Supports video uploads, clip extraction, timeline previews, export to 1080p MP4, and management of credits and session status.
- Provides clear actions based on user prompts (export, upload, credits, status, editing commands).
- Error handling for issues such as token expiry, file limits, and unsupported formats.
- No local installation required—processing and rendering are performed on remote servers.
